people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
translations.bsb: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
translations.kjv: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
